Even when it looks like the end, there may be a seed of something better.

Kevin Trudeau tells of a huge legal judgment he could not pay. He expected everything to be taken, from the houses to the forks and knives, and every business shut down.

His answer was a belief he keeps coming back to: in every adversity are the seeds of a greater benefit.

When things go wrong, which do you notice first, the loss or the seed?
